page.title: 位置で変わる、形容詞の顔

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、名詞の前で限定することを得意とするmain・only・former、連結動詞の後ろで状態を表すasleep・afraid・alive・awake・alone、さらにcertain・late・present・oldのように位置によって意味が変わる形容詞を扱う。
grammarPoints: main・only・formerは通常、名詞の前で種類や範囲を限定する
asleep・afraid・alive・awake・aloneは通常、連結動詞の後ろで状態を説明する
a certain＋名詞は「ある特定の」、be certainは「確信している」を表す
present＋名詞は「現在の」、名詞＋be presentは「その場にいる」を表す
an old friendは長年の友人、The friend is oldは高齢という意味になりやすい
visualEvidence: 前置ゲートと状態説明ゲートが、形容詞ごとの得意な位置を分けている
表裏を返すメダルがcertain・present・oldなどの意味変化を示している
前側は種類の札、後ろ側は一時的な状態の光として描かれている
commonTraps: an asleep customerのように状態形容詞を名詞前へ置く
The manager is formerのように前置専用語をそのまま述語にする
a certain supplierとThe supplier is certainの意味を同じと考える
presentやoldの位置による意味差を無視する

questions.prompt: Please use the ------- entrance while the side door is being repaired.

choices.C: main
choices.D: mained

questions.translationJa: 横扉の修理中は正面入口を使用してください。
questions.explanationJa: mainは名詞entranceの前で主要な入口を限定します。

questions.prompt: The ------- regional director will speak at the anniversary event.

choices.C: form
choices.D: formal

questions.translationJa: 前地域部長が周年行事で講演します。
questions.explanationJa: formerは名詞の前で「以前の」を表します。

questions.prompt: This is the ------- signed copy of the contract in our files.

choices.C: solely copy
choices.D: only

questions.translationJa: これは当社ファイルにある唯一の署名済み契約書です。
questions.explanationJa: onlyは名詞句の前で唯一であることを限定します。

questions.prompt: The night guard remained ------- throughout the emergency drill.

choices.C: awakely
choices.D: wakingly

questions.translationJa: 夜間警備員は緊急訓練中ずっと起きていました。
questions.explanationJa: awakeはremainの後ろでguardの状態を説明します。

questions.prompt: Several passengers were ------- of missing their connecting flight.

choices.C: fear
choices.D: frighteningly

questions.explanationJa: afraidはbe動詞後で人の心理状態を表します。

questions.prompt: The backup server is still ------- despite the power interruption.

choices.D: alively

questions.explanationJa: 比喩的にaliveをbe動詞後へ置き、機能している状態を表します。

questions.prompt: A ------- vendor has requested a confidential meeting with the buyer.

choices.C: certainty
choices.D: certifiedly

questions.translationJa: ある特定の業者が購買担当者との非公開会議を求めています。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞前のcertainは名前を明かさない特定の業者を表します。

questions.prompt: We are ------- that the replacement parts will arrive by Friday.

choices.C: certify
choices.D: certain

questions.translationJa: 交換部品が金曜日までに届くと確信しています。
questions.explanationJa: be certainは「確信している」という状態を表します。

questions.prompt: The ------- operations manager introduced a new reporting system.

choices.D: presentation

questions.explanationJa: 名詞前のpresentは「現在の」を表します。

questions.prompt: All employees ------- at the briefing must sign the attendance sheet.

choices.C: presence
choices.D: presenting

questions.translationJa: 説明会に出席している全従業員は出席票に署名しなければなりません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying the principal office.

choices.B: The main office is located beside the station.
choices.C: The mainly office is located beside the station.
choices.D: The office main is located beside the station.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a person who previously worked here.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a sleeping child.

choices.B: An asleep child is in the waiting room.
choices.C: The asleep child is in the waiting room.
choices.D: The child asleeply is in the waiting room.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing employees who feel fear.

choices.A: The afraid employees of the sudden system failure are.
choices.B: The employees afraidly are of the sudden system failure.
choices.C: The employees are afraid of the sudden system failure.
choices.D: The employees are fear of the sudden system failure.

questions.translationJa: 従業員は突然のシステム障害を恐れています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying the single feasible route.

choices.A: This delivery route is only feasible one.
choices.B: This is the alone feasible delivery route.
choices.C: This is the feasible only delivery route.
choices.D: This is the only feasible delivery route.

choices.B: A certain customer called about invoice 408.
choices.C: A certainly customer called about invoice 408.
choices.D: The customer called certainly about invoice 408.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning that the director is sure.

choices.A: The certain director that the figures are correct.
choices.B: The director certain figures are correct.
choices.C: The director is certain that the figures are correct.
choices.D: The director is certainly the figures are correct.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence referring to the current branch manager.

choices.B: The branch manager is present joined the company in 2014.
choices.C: The presently branch manager joined the company in 2014.
choices.D: The branch present manager joined the company in 2014.

questions.translationJa: 現在の支店長は2014年に入社しました。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞前のpresentは現在の役職者を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence stating that Ms. Patel arrived after the scheduled time.

choices.A: The late Ms. Patel is for the supplier meeting.
choices.B: Ms. Patel is lately for the supplier meeting.
choices.C: A late Ms. Patel meeting is supplier.
choices.D: Ms. Patel is late for the supplier meeting.

questions.translationJa: パテルさんは仕入先会議に遅れています。
questions.explanationJa: be lateは時間に遅れている状態を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating that a technician has no companions.

choices.A: An alone technician is in the control room.
choices.B: The technician is alone in the control room.
choices.C: The alone technician is in the control room.
choices.D: The technician alonely is in the control room.

questions.explanationJa: aloneは通常be動詞後で状態を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Reducing errors is our main goal."

choices.B: Our goal is to report errors rather than reduce them.
choices.C: The main office has reduced its staffing goal.
choices.D: Reducing errors is our primary goal.

questions.explanationJa: mainはprimaryと同じく主要なものを限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The former manager visited the branch."

choices.C: The manager visited before the branch opened.
choices.D: A formal manager inspected the branch.

questions.translationJa: 以前その支店を管理していた人が訪問しました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This is the only key to the archive."

choices.B: This key opens every office except the archive.
choices.C: There is no other key to the archive.
choices.D: The archive key is currently missing.

questions.translationJa: 保管庫の鍵はこれ以外にありません。
questions.explanationJa: onlyがkeyを唯一のものに限定しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The guard stayed awake all night."

choices.A: The guard did not fall asleep during the night.
choices.B: The guard left the building before nightfall.
choices.C: The guard woke every visitor during the night.

questions.translationJa: 警備員は夜の間眠りませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: awakeは眠っていない状態を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The staff were afraid of losing the data."

choices.A: The staff deleted the data without concern.
choices.B: The staff feared that the data might be lost.
choices.C: The data frightened customers but not the staff.
choices.D: The staff were certain that all data was safe.

questions.explanationJa: be afraid ofは恐れる気持ちを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "A certain supplier requested an audit."

choices.A: Every supplier was certain that an audit was required.
choices.B: The supplier requested certainty about the audit date.
choices.C: An auditor selected a reliable supplier.
choices.D: One specific supplier, whose name is not given, requested an audit.

questions.translationJa: 名前を示していないある特定の仕入先が監査を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: 前置certainは「ある特定の」という限定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I am certain that the order shipped."

choices.A: I am sure that the order shipped.
choices.B: A certain order was shipped to me.
choices.C: I shipped only the orders marked certain.

choices.A: The chairperson who attended approved only a present.
choices.B: A former chairperson presented the agenda.
choices.C: The current chairperson approved the agenda.
choices.D: The chairperson was absent when the agenda was approved.

questions.translationJa: 現在の議長が議題を承認しました。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The chairperson is present."

choices.A: The chairperson is here and attending.
choices.C: The chairperson will present the annual report.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Ms. Reed is an old colleague of mine."

choices.B: Ms. Reed left the company yesterday.
choices.C: I have never worked with Ms. Reed.
choices.D: I have known Ms. Reed as a colleague for many years.

questions.explanationJa: an old colleagueは年齢より長い付き合いを表すことがあります。

questions.prompt: Visitors should enter through the door facing the parking lot. It is the ------- entrance to the facility.

choices.C: main

questions.prompt: Mr. Nolan left the company last year but still advises us. The ------- finance director will join tomorrow's call.

questions.prompt: Every other delivery method would miss the deadline. Air freight is our ------- option.

questions.prompt: The guest has not responded since the overnight flight began. She appears to be ------- in seat 12A.

questions.prompt: The complaint does not name the caller publicly. It says that a ------- client experienced repeated delays.

questions.explanationJa: a certain clientは名前を伏せた特定の顧客です。

questions.prompt: Tracking data shows the parcel at the local depot. We are ------- it will arrive this afternoon.

choices.C: certify
choices.D: certain

questions.explanationJa: be certain thatの省略された内容を文脈から読み、確信を表します。

questions.prompt: The policy now on the website replaced the 2024 edition. Please follow the ------- travel policy.

choices.C: presence

questions.explanationJa: presentを名詞前に置くとcurrentの意味です。

questions.prompt: Attendance is required for certification. All participants ------- must sign the register before leaving.

choices.C: present
choices.D: presenting

questions.translationJa: 認定には出席が必要です。その場にいる参加者全員は退出前に名簿へ署名してください。
questions.explanationJa: participantsの後ろのpresentは出席している人を表します。
